item.description:
Misty Kiss Lock Color Matte Lipstick

Misty lock-in color, long-lasting allure. With a velvety mist texture, it is smooth and rich without drying out, creating a stunning effect with a single stroke. The film-forming lock-in makeup technology ensures long-lasting, non-transferable color, preserving the misty finish and creating a sophisticated soft-focus lip makeup.

• Cream to powder color retention technology
• Applies like a raw chocolate
• 24 hours lasting
• non-stick cup
• Anti-mask
• water proof
• Waterproof/long-lasting matte lips
• Non-stick cups, non-stick masks

How to Use?
• Step 1 Apply evenly to lips
• Step 2 Wait for about 10s to form a film
